title: Sliding Window Maximum
statement:
You are given an array of integers `A`, there is a sliding window of size `K` which is moving from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the `K` numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position.

Return an array of the maximums of each window.

You must solve this in O(N) time using a Monotonic Deque.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N - K + 1 space-separated integers representing the maximums.

examples.explanation: Window size is 1, so the array is unchanged.

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque

a = list(map(int, input().split()))
